name: neuralmind
summary: Persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Cline, Continue and any MCP client. Learns which files go together from how you work and serves compact, ranked context: the gold file on 40 of 40 public-benchmark queries to keyword ripgrep's 32 of 40, at 31-67× fewer tokens than ripgrep and 51-242× fewer than pasting every source file (a larger 150-question eval misses 10). Local-first, no telemetry by default.
